fortran.note: ifort is not installed on this host, so gfortran reproduces the -r8/-i4 precision contract only. This is not a claim of ifort-identical code generation. gfortran 16 implements the Fortran 2023 SPLIT intrinsic, which shadows this project's split.f and makes soil.f fail with 'Too many arguments in call to split' even though the call is correct (split.f declares 10 arguments, soil.f passes 10). Declare EXTERNAL split after that unit's header, or compile that one unit with -std=f95.
